sourcePolicy.actualCollections: Separate dataset. Never combine with advance bookings.
sourcePolicy.independenceRule: Secondary publications citing a primary tracker are not independent measurements.
sourcePolicy.comparisonRule: Compare matching dates, territories, gross/net definitions, blocked-seat treatment and timestamps.

actualCollections.note: Actual theatrical collections are separate from advance-booking figures.

sacnilk.note: Sacnilk is registered as a primary source. Automated comparison requires its exact Ramayana tracker URL and a compatible parser.

secondary.note: The Week, Financial Express and Koimoi are not counted as independent measurements when they cite a primary tracker.

ingestion.note: Successful page parsing does not guarantee publisher estimate accuracy or producer confirmation.
